**STEP 1 - Scene:** A lunch tray with a chicken and cabbage slaw salad on a paper plate, a chicken sub sandwich (cut in half, with cheese) on a second paper plate, and a cup of black coffee.

**STEP 2 - Vessel:** Main plate (slaw) is about 23 cm, area ≈ 415 cm². Sandwich plate is about 20 cm, area ≈ 314 cm². Both are part of the tray meal.

**STEP 3 - Items:** Shredded cabbage and carrot slaw with dressing; shredded chicken; sub bread (two halves); chicken filling in the sandwich; cheese slice; some lettuce/vegetable in the sandwich. Coffee is excluded (negligible energy).

**STEP 4 - Area (of each vessel):**
- Slaw plate: slaw ~45% of plate area (≈187 cm²), shredded chicken ~15% (≈62 cm²). Food covers about 60% of this plate.
- Sandwich plate: bread halves ~35% (≈110 cm²), filling and cheese ~10% (≈31 cm²). Food covers about 45% of this plate.

**STEP 5 - Volume:**
- Slaw: 187 cm² × 2.5 cm ≈ 467 ml
- Chicken on salad: 62 cm² × 1.5 cm ≈ 93 ml
- Bread: 110 cm² × 3 cm ≈ 330 ml
- Sandwich filling and cheese: 31 cm² × 1.5 cm ≈ 47 ml

**STEP 6 - Grams:**
- Slaw: 467 ml × 0.2 ≈ 93 g
- Chicken on salad: 93 ml × 0.9 ≈ 84 g
- Bread (two halves): 330 ml × 0.3 ≈ 100 g, rounded up to 110 g since the sub is dense at the crust
- Sandwich chicken filling: ≈ 50 g
- Cheese: ≈ 10 g
- Sandwich vegetables: ≈ 20 g

**STEP 7 - Energy:**
- Slaw with dressing: 93 g × 90 kcal/100 g ≈ 84 kcal
- Chicken (salad): 84 g × 165 ≈ 139 kcal
- Bread: 110 g × 270 ≈ 297 kcal
- Sandwich chicken: 50 g × 165 ≈ 83 kcal
- Cheese: 10 g × 350 ≈ 35 kcal
- Vegetables: 20 g × 25 ≈ 5 kcal

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** The total is about 363 g and about 643 kcal. That fits a full salad plate plus a half-to-whole sub, so it is plausible.
